raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

A decode iteration can increment nine Prometheus counters by zero. With the multiprocess mmap backend, each call still takes a lock and writes the value. This change skips those writes in the stats logger.

## Claims

- **28% lower CPU time** for complete multiprocess decode logger calls: **3.64 s → 2.62 s** in the benchmark below.
- Zero-valued series, positive increments, label checks, and exemplar behavior are preserved.

## Validation

The benchmark runs complete `PrometheusStatLogger.record` calls on one CPU core. Each call records four generated tokens and four token latencies. Each version has 100 warmup calls and three timed runs of 30,000 calls.

| Counter backend | Baseline CPU median (range) | Patch CPU median (range) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Multiprocess mmap | 3.64 s (3.40–4.36) | 2.62 s (2.59–3.17) |
| Standard mutex | 0.79 s (0.78–0.79) | 0.80 s (0.78–0.88) |

Live checks used Qwen3-0.6B on one L4 and one CPU, with the real mmap backend. All 40 responses matched text, token IDs, finish and stop reasons, and usage. Streaming chunks and generation-token totals also matched. Request-time medians were 15.711 s and 15.730 s. API CPU medians were 0.775 s and 0.855 s, with overlapping ranges of 0.65–1.44 s and 0.74–1.68 s. The patch API CPU median was 10.3% higher. These results do not confirm lower whole-API CPU cost or request time; the 28% claim applies to logger calls.

Tests run:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/metrics/test_engine_logger_apis.py -q -k zero_counter
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/metrics/test_histogram_buckets.py tests/v1/metrics/test_stats.py -q
```

**31 native tests passed**: two counter tests, 14 histogram tests, and 15 stats tests. Full logger comparisons matched all 644 non-creation-timestamp samples across idle, decode, prefill, multimodal-cache, and completed-request cases on both backends. Counter contract checks passed 28 amount/exemplar cases on each of Prometheus client 0.18.0 and 0.26.0. Local pre-commit and Python 3.12 mypy checks passed. Upstream test CI is blocked by the contributor gate.

After the main update, all applicable pre-commit hooks passed. CPU source checks with Prometheus client 0.26.0 passed 28 counter-contract comparisons on each backend. The new admission counters also preserved zero-valued series and positive increments. Custom counter selection was preserved. These checks use exact source snippets and the real SDK; they do not run full vLLM logger initialization or serving. No new speed result or GPU/model run is claimed.

## Details

Open PR searches found no other fix that skips zero-valued multiprocess counter increments. [#60001](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60001) and [#60038](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60038) initialize gauges. This change reduces repeated counter writes after series initialization.

`MultiprocessCounter` returns early for a zero increment without an exemplar, after checking label values. Other calls use the SDK's `Counter.inc`. The logger selects this class only for the standard counter type with the multiprocess backend. The normal mutex backend and custom classes, including the Ray wrapper, keep their current implementations. Series are still created during label initialization.

The extra check also runs on positive multiprocess increments. The complete logger benchmark includes that cost. The change uses the existing logger module and test suite.

<details>
<summary>Benchmark reproduction and test environment</summary>

Use this [benchmark script](https://github.com/spa5k/vllm/blob/861615a3a6d88c0ec0aaa922570a47c2e06f9a3e/benchmarks/benchmark_stat_logger.py), saved as `/tmp/vllm_metric_benchmark.py`. Run each command on the base and patch:

```bash
.venv/bin/python /tmp/vllm_metric_benchmark.py --multiprocess --iterations 30000 --repetitions 3 --output-json mmap.json
.venv/bin/python /tmp/vllm_metric_benchmark.py --iterations 30000 --repetitions 3 --output-json mutex.json
```

The script creates a fresh multiprocess directory before importing the SDK and records the actual counter and value classes. Unset any existing `PROMETHEUS_MULTIPROC_DIR` for the mutex run.

Tests used Linux, Python 3.12, and the prebuilt [vLLM 0.31.1rc1.dev56+ge572e02d2 wheel](https://wheels.vllm.ai/e572e02d21b2b3559b3ce33adb117dca3f50ccd7/vllm-0.31.1rc1.dev56%2Bge572e02d2-cp38-abi3-manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl), with the candidate Python files installed. The affected baseline sources matched the checked PR base. This was a wheel-based environment; the full current source tree was not compiled. No compiled code changed. The main benchmark used Prometheus client 0.26.0.

Live tests used one warm API process and `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` at revision `c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca`. Eight timed groups each had four requests of 2,048 tokens, in baseline/patch/patch/baseline order twice. Two more groups checked streaming at 1,024 tokens per request. No per-token timers were used in the timed groups. This checks one API process using mmap, rather than throughput across several API processes.

</details>

AI assistance was used.

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>

@@ -3,12 +3,14 @@
 import copy
 
 import pytest
+from prometheus_client import CollectorRegistry
 
 from tests.plugins.vllm_add_dummy_stat_logger.dummy_stat_logger.dummy_stat_logger import (  # noqa E501
     DummyStatLogger,
 )
 from tests.utils import wait_for_memory_to_settle
 from vllm.v1.engine.async_llm import AsyncEngineArgs, AsyncLLM
+from vllm.v1.metrics.loggers import MultiprocessCounter
 from vllm.v1.metrics.ray_wrappers import RayPrometheusStatLogger
 
 
@@ -25,6 +27,33 @@ def log_stats_enabled_engine_args():
     )
 
 
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+def test_zero_counter_increment_keeps_initialized_series_and_validation():
+    registry = CollectorRegistry()
+    counter = MultiprocessCounter("requests", "Requests", ["engine"], registry=registry)
+    labeled = counter.labels("0")
+    assert registry.get_sample_value("requests_total", {"engine": "0"}) == 0
+    labeled.inc(0)
+    assert registry.get_sample_value("requests_total", {"engine": "0"}) == 0
+    labeled.inc(0.5)
+    labeled.inc(0)
+    assert registry.get_sample_value("requests_total", {"engine": "0"}) == 0.5
+    assert registry.get_sample_value("requests_total", {"engine": "1"}) is None
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="missing label values"):
+        counter.inc(0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+def test_zero_counter_increment_keeps_exemplar():
+    counter = MultiprocessCounter("requests", "Requests", registry=CollectorRegistry())
+    counter.inc(0, exemplar={"trace_id": "abc"})
+    sample = next(s for s in counter.collect()[0].samples if s.name == "requests_total")
+    assert sample.value == 0
+    assert sample.exemplar is not None
+    assert sample.exemplar.value == 0
+    assert sample.exemplar.labels == {"trace_id": "abc"}
+
+
 @pytest.mark.asyncio
 async def test_async_llm_replace_default_loggers(log_stats_enabled_engine_args):
     """RayPrometheusStatLogger should replace the default PrometheusStatLogger."""

@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
 from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
 from collections.abc import Callable
 
-from prometheus_client import Counter, Gauge, Histogram
+from prometheus_client import Counter, Gauge, Histogram, values
 
 import vllm.envs as envs
 from vllm.compilation.cuda_graph import CUDAGraphLogging
@@ -470,6 +470,14 @@ def log_engine_initialized(self):
             per_engine_stat_logger.log_engine_initialized()
 
 
+class MultiprocessCounter(Counter):
+    def inc(self, amount: float = 1, exemplar: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> None:
+        if amount == 0 and exemplar is None:
+            self._raise_if_not_observable()
+            return
+        Counter.inc(self, amount, exemplar)
+
+
 class PrometheusStatLogger(AggregateStatLoggerBase):
